text_block_list.text:
—A day off. I spotted Grass Wonder and 
Hishi Amazon in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Fufu, hello.
choice_data_list: Are you two going out together?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to go shopping for dorm supplies 
with Hishi Ama-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for troubling you every time. You're 
the only one who steps up to help without 
being asked.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, no, something like this is an 
easy-peasy job~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you sure~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please do! We can never have 
too many helping hands!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I shall gratefully accept 
Trainer's kindness~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's split into two groups here 
for now. Grass, you're paired with them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Should we buy groceries or daily 
necessities? Which do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, for general 
goods... we had a lot to buy, didn't we~?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer
text_block_list.text:
Get 'em cheap, cheap prices here! Our 
special sale items are marked down even 
further starting now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it looks like a flash sale has just 
started at the greengrocer's.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, which one would you prefer~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a coincidence. I was just 
thinking the exact same thing~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm on general goods duty. I'll 
leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A lot of people have gathered in front of 
the shop, haven't they...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There is no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly fond of crowds or 
noisy places, but this is a battle, after 
all~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Nothing ventured, nothing gained, as they 
say. Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be on my way—

In the blink of an eye, Grass Wonder 
deftly weaves her way through the crowd of 
housewives.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I'll just get in line here, if 
you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Housewife A
text_block_list.text: Out of the way—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—Excuse me, would you mind waiting 
properly in line?"

Along the way, she lightly danced past a 
housewife trying to cut in line and shove 
her aside...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I took some of 
these carrots?

text_block_list.name: Housewife B
text_block_list.text: H-Here you go...!

After checking with the people around me, 
I picked up a carrot on flash sale.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew... Quite a haul of spoils.
choice_data_list:
That was incredible in all sorts of 
ways...

text_block_list.text:
Conquering a flash sale without losing 
one's composure or manners in the 
slightest is no ordinary feat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. This is really no big deal――

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text: Get 'em cheap! Cheap prices here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a flash sale at that shop over 
there too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, shall we be on our way then~♪

While hopping between flash sales at 
various shops, I ended up with a 
ridiculous amount of luggage.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I got a little carried away...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, don't worry about it! All the kids 
at my place are huge eaters anyway!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-senpai... Thank you very much.

Grass Wonder's competitive spirit seemed 
to be fully on display, even when running 
simple errands.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since there are so many things to buy, it 
might be best for us to handle the 
sundries~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm on food duty, then! I'll 
leave the general goods to you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, making you carry my bags 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer, I think I can 
stock up on more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hand soap refill is done. Next is 
refilling the detergent and air 
freshener...
choice_data_list: It's all refill packs, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Saving money is important. Besides, 
there's a little bonus later... fufu♪

Having successfully finished buying the 
sundries, I met back up with Hishi Amazon 
and handed her the change.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... Oh, looks like you 
saved some money for us, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You saved me, Grass! You really are a 
wonderful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. It's all thanks to Trainer 
helping out too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, as thanks, Big Sis Hishiama 
will treat ya to a snack!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much~. In that case, 
would it be all right if I asked for some 
tea snacks?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking I'd love to host an outdoor 
tea ceremony with everyone. What do you 
say~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now that's a brilliant idea!

"After that, I enjoyed a relaxing tea time 
with Grass Wonder and the others."
